hyperedges.label: Version consistency gates (version.go = pkgver = CHANGELOG entry)

nodes.label: IMPORTANT: keep the reminder string free of backticks and $(...) constructs.
nodes.norm_label: important: keep the reminder string free of backticks and $(...) constructs.

nodes.label: Auto Tag workflow (auto-tag.yml)
nodes.rationale: Productively-lazy half of the release pipeline: watches main, creates an annotated tag only when both version files match AND CHANGELOG has a matching entry; idempotent for docs-only pushes.

nodes.label: GITHUB_TOKEN recursion guard
nodes.rationale: A tag pushed with GITHUB_TOKEN does NOT trigger other workflows (GitHub recursion guard), so release.yml and aur-publish.yml are dispatched explicitly via workflow_dispatch.

nodes.label: Release workflow (release.yml)
nodes.rationale: On v* tag push or explicit workflow_dispatch: re-checks both version files and the CHANGELOG entry, cross-compiles 6 targets, generates SHA-256 checksums, creates GitHub Release; pre-release auto-detected when version contains '-'.

nodes.label: AUR Publish workflow (aur-publish.yml)
nodes.rationale: Ships the odm-bin AUR package via RELEASE and REPUBLISH modes; custom scripts/aur-sync.sh prunes stale assets; .SRCINFO regenerated at publish time.

nodes.label: AUR RELEASE mode
nodes.rationale: New versions: bumps pkgver, resets pkgrel to 1, pulls real binary checksums from release artifacts, verifies via makepkg --verifysource (archlinux docker), publishes, commits PKGBUILD back to main.

nodes.label: AUR REPUBLISH mode
nodes.rationale: Already-released version: bumps pkgrel above upstream AUR (or keeps local when ahead); skips silently when untagged or PKGBUILD byte-identical to upstream AUR (defensive loop guard).

nodes.label: CI workflow (ci.yml)
nodes.rationale: Gates every push + PR: go mod download, go build, go vet, golangci-lint v2.12.2 with .golangci.yml, go test -race -count=1, plus a version-consistency check so a partial bump can't land on main.

nodes.label: Dependabot updates
nodes.rationale: Weekly automated updates for gomod (10 open PRs) and github-actions (5 open PRs), both labeled 'dependencies'; added in v1.0.0.

nodes.label: golangci-lint v2 config (.golangci.yml)
nodes.rationale: Broader-but-conservative lint baseline over plain go vet: unconvert + staticcheck all-minus-ST1012, comments/common-false-positives excluded, zero tolerated issues; British spelling intentional so misspell is not enabled.

nodes.label: ST1012 disabled (NoControlFile)
nodes.rationale: staticcheck ST1012 (error vars must be ErrFoo) disabled because the sentinel NoControlFile in internal/storage/resume.go is intentionally human-readable per the PRD §11.3 contract.

nodes.label: errcheck exclusions (defer Close / fmt.Fprint)
nodes.rationale: Two errcheck patterns excluded as intentional CLI idioms: deferred x.Close() on shutdown can't handle errors usefully; fmt.Fprint* terminal/log output is best-effort.

nodes.label: ODM architecture (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: Single binary cmd/odm/main.go wires together internal packages; two execution modes: CLI one-shot (default) and RPC daemon (--rpc); module path is 'odm'.

nodes.label: Version consistency rule
nodes.rationale: Version single-sourced in internal/version/version.go; config.Version and download.Version are compile-time aliases so they can never drift; PKGBUILD pkgver checked by CI/auto-tag/release; auto-tag also gates on a CHANGELOG ## [X.Y.Z] header so release notes are never empty.

nodes.label: ODM changelog (Keep a Changelog format)
nodes.rationale: Documents all notable changes for ODM (Oryn Download Manager); format based on Keep a Changelog, adheres to Semantic Versioning; entries 0.1.0 (2026-07-25) to 1.3.0 (2026-08-01), each naming the affected internal packages.

nodes.label: Semantic Versioning
nodes.rationale: Adhered to per semver.org v2.0.0; tag format v<semver>, pre-releases contain '-' (e.g. v0.2.0-rc1).

nodes.label: True SOCKS5 / SOCKS5h proxy support
nodes.rationale: --proxy socks5:// and socks5h:// speak the SOCKS5 protocol (RFC 1928) instead of HTTP CONNECT tunnelling; socks5 resolves locally, socks5h sends hostname for proxy-side DNS; uses golang.org/x/net/proxy.

nodes.label: Per-chunk resume verification (SHA-256)
nodes.rationale: The .odm control file now records a SHA-256 hash per completed chunk; resuming verifies every completed chunk from local disk so silent disk corruption is caught; legacy control files keep the server-side spot-check.

nodes.label: v1.2.0 (2026-07-31) — chunk re-queue, resume integrity checks
nodes.rationale: Correctness headline: single-stream downloads can no longer silently corrupt files, ^C exits with code 4, --checksum verifies the actual written file, failed chunks re-queued, resume spot-checks against the server, bounded control-file flushing, atomic slot admission.
nodes.norm_label: v1.2.0 (2026-07-31) — chunk re-queue, resume integrity checks

nodes.label: Failed chunk re-queue (bounded by --retry)
nodes.rationale: A worker that exhausts its per-chunk retry budget returns the chunk to the queue (bounded by --retry worker-level passes) instead of failing the task, so one transient range error doesn't discard the rest of the file.

nodes.label: v1.1.0 (2026-07-29) — dynamic rate limiting, mid-flight reallocation
nodes.rationale: changeOption became a real mutation endpoint (max-download-limit, max-download-limit-per-task, connections); workers added/removed mid-flight with graceful drain; progress bar shows live downloaded/total sizes.
nodes.norm_label: v1.1.0 (2026-07-29) — dynamic rate limiting, mid-flight reallocation

nodes.label: Mid-flight connection reallocation (AdjustConns)
nodes.rationale: Task.AdjustConns(target) changes the desired connection count at runtime: reduction retires excess workers gracefully before pulling the next chunk, increase spawns new worker goroutines; RPC key 'connections'.

nodes.label: RPC odm.changeOption mutation endpoint
nodes.rationale: No longer a no-op; supports keys max-download-limit (global token bucket SetRate), max-download-limit-per-task, and connections; other RPC spec mutations remain deferred.

nodes.label: v1.0.0 (2026-07-27) — production-ready release
nodes.rationale: TLS, systemd, ETag validation, final UI polish; all roadmap items from AGENTS.md implemented; CLI, RPC daemon, progress bar and resume engine stable and tested under -race.

nodes.label: TLS for RPC (--rpc-tls-cert / --rpc-tls-key)
nodes.rationale: Enables HTTPS/WSS on the RPC listener via http.ServeTLS; both flags must be provided together.

nodes.label: systemd service unit (packaging/odm.service)
nodes.rationale: Security-hardened unit: DynamicUser=yes, ProtectSystem=strict, PrivateTmp=yes, NoNewPrivileges=yes, EnvironmentFile support for /etc/odm/odm.env.

nodes.label: ETag validation on resume
nodes.rationale: On --continue, the stored ETag from the .odm control file is compared against the server's current ETag; if both are non-empty and differ, the file is re-downloaded from scratch to prevent corruption.

nodes.label: v0.3.0 (2026-07-26) — colored ILoveCandy UI, transport timeouts
nodes.rationale: ANSI colors on pacman bar; DialContext + TLSHandshakeTimeout replace per-request timeouts; scheduler uses Balancer's per-file allocation instead of global -c; PKGBUILD converted to -bin package.
nodes.norm_label: v0.3.0 (2026-07-26) — colored ilovecandy ui, transport timeouts
nodes.community_name: v0.3.0 (2026-07-26) — colored ILoveCandy UI, transport timeouts

nodes.label: v0.2.0 (2026-07-26) — richer control file, CI lint
nodes.rationale: Richer .odm control files (timestamps, connections, user agent, ODM version, checksum; all omitempty), periodic resume checkpoints every 5 chunks, golangci-lint v2 integrated into CI, CHANGELOG.md added.
nodes.norm_label: v0.2.0 (2026-07-26) — richer control file, ci lint
nodes.community_name: v0.2.0 (2026-07-26) — richer control file, CI lint

nodes.label: v0.1.0 (2026-07-25) — initial MVP
nodes.rationale: Initial MVP — single-binary CLI download manager inspired by aria2c; three core features: Connection Balancer (modes A/B/C), pacman/ILoveCandy progress bar, JSON-RPC 2.0 + WebSocket control surface (14 methods, 5 events); exit codes 0-4 established.

nodes.label: Version const (internal/version/version.go)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth: const Version = "odm/X.Y.Z"; config.Version and download.Version are compile-time aliases of version.Version so a mismatch is a build error; release checklist is version.go + PKGBUILD pkgver (2 locations).

nodes.label: packaging/PKGBUILD (AUR odm-bin package)
nodes.rationale: pkgver must match internal/version/version.go (checked by ci.yml, auto-tag.yml, release.yml); -bin package downloading pre-built binaries since 0.3.0; .SRCINFO generated at publish time, not tracked.

nodes.label: cmd/odm (entry point, mode dispatch)
nodes.rationale: Single binary main.go wires together the internal packages; two execution modes: CLI one-shot (default) and RPC daemon (--rpc); reuses CLI probe results per task via SetProbe (no double probe since 1.2.0); maps user cancel to ExitCancelled.

nodes.label: internal/download (Task lifecycle, chunk queue, Manager)
nodes.rationale: Task lifecycle, work-stealing chunk queue (NewChunkQueue validates contiguous non-overlapping chunks), Manager, exit codes (download.Exit* constants); estimateETA lives in task.go; exposes ProgressView via Task.Snapshot().

nodes.label: internal/scheduler (Connection Balancer, Daemon, Queue)
nodes.rationale: Connection Balancer (allocation modes A/B/C via Compute, per-file a.Connections), Daemon (RPC-facing), Queue (atomic slot admission, bounded task retention, 200ms drain wait on cancel).

nodes.label: internal/ui (progress bar, prompt, terminal sizing)
nodes.rationale: Pacman/ILoveCandy progress bar (render.go pure / progress.go stateful), confirmation prompt, terminal sizing; CJK/emoji filenames measured in display cells; bar shrinks on narrow terminals.

nodes.label: internal/rpc (JSON-RPC 2.0 + WebSocket server)
nodes.rationale: JSON-RPC 2.0 + WebSocket server with Broadcaster; odm.shutdown replies before stopping; WebSocket subscribers don't leak on write failure; reads task state via Task.Snapshot().

nodes.label: internal/ratelimit (global token bucket)
nodes.rationale: Global token bucket for --limit-rate; SetRate updates it at runtime via RPC since 1.1.0; limiter and per-task limiter held atomically to avoid data races.

nodes.label: internal/storage (File WriteAt, .odm resume files)
nodes.rationale: File WriteAt (concurrent writers must use disjoint byte ranges, guaranteed by chunk boundaries), resume control files (.odm, per-chunk hashes), sentinel NoControlFile; pre-allocation via os.Truncate.

nodes.label: Task.Snapshot() read API
nodes.rationale: Snapshot() is the read API for task state - UI and RPC both read download.ProgressView via Task.Snapshot(); write path is atomic fields (conns, speed, bytesDone, state).

nodes.label: Automated release pipeline
nodes.rationale: Push version bump to main, auto-tag.yml validates and tags, release.yml cross-compiles + creates GitHub Release, aur-publish.yml ships AUR; commit-backs to main re-run auto-tag which skips (tag exists) - no loop.

nodes.label: ETA format HH:MM:SS (colETA=8)
nodes.rationale: ETA is 8 cells (HH:MM:SS), FormatDuration caps at 99:59:59; estimateETA in task.go must NOT multiply by time.Second a second time - the inner expression already yields nanoseconds.

nodes.label: render.go pure / progress.go stateful split
nodes.rationale: internal/ui/render.go is the pure rendering layer (Bar, BarIndeterminate, renderTaskLine); internal/ui/progress.go owns the stateful Renderer (cache, animation tick, TTY redraw loop); bar width fixed at 30 cells so the percent column never shifts.

nodes.label: Mid-flight dynamic reallocation (roadmap)
nodes.rationale: Roadmap item, not a bug: rebalancing chunks already being downloaded, beyond the implemented connection-count adjustment via AdjustConns; requires live goroutine renegotiation.

nodes.label: HTTP/2 / HTTP/3 multiplexing deliberately excluded
nodes.rationale: The whole point of ODM is multi-connection aggregation over HTTP/1.1; HTTP/2/3 stream multiplexing would require a new Balancer mode that ignores the connection budget.

nodes.label: Reference Web UI (roadmap)
nodes.rationale: Roadmap item built on the RPC + WebSocket layer.

nodes.label: ODM README
nodes.rationale: User-facing doc: ODM (Oryn Download Manager) is a CLI download manager in Go inspired by aria2c, single static binary with no runtime dependencies.

nodes.label: aria2c (inspiration)
nodes.rationale: ODM is inspired by aria2c; its RPC server gives other programs the same driving relationship aria2c has with AriaNg.

nodes.label: Connection Balancer (modes A/B/C)
nodes.rationale: Core differentiator: automatic allocation of parallel connections between single-file (A) and batch (B/C) modes from one budget (-c); --max-connections (32) is a soft ceiling; range-failing files capped to 1 conn with budget redistribution.

nodes.label: Work-stealing chunk queue
nodes.rationale: Each file splits into small chunks (default --chunk-size 4M) in a shared per-file queue; worker goroutines - one per allocated connection - pull the next chunk, avoiding the straggler problem of static equal-split.

nodes.label: .odm resume control file
nodes.rationale: With -x/--continue (default on) each download writes a <file>.odm control file recording done chunks; on re-run only unfinished chunks are re-fetched; deleted on clean completion; since 1.3.0 records per-chunk SHA-256 hashes.

nodes.label: Pacman/ILoveCandy progress bar
nodes.rationale: CachyOS ILoveCandy-style bar with connection indicator, fixed BarWidth=30, ETA HH:MM:SS capped 99:59:59, state-colored, auto-disabled on non-TTY; hybrid BytesDone/Total since 1.1.0.

nodes.label: JSON-RPC 2.0 + WebSocket RPC server
nodes.rationale: Daemon mode (--rpc) so third-party GUIs/scripts can drive ODM without parsing terminal output; binds 127.0.0.1 by default; aria2-style token:<secret> auth; 14 methods and 5 WebSocket events over /ws fan-out carrying tellStatus's field set.

nodes.label: Exit codes 0-4
nodes.rationale: 0=all succeeded, 1=general error/invalid argument, 2=network error (retries exhausted), 3=partial batch failure, 4=cancelled; defined by download.Exit* constants.

nodes.label: Global + per-task token bucket rate limiting
nodes.rationale: --limit-rate is a global token bucket shared across all workers of all tasks, throttling at the data-stream level; --limit-rate-per-task stacks a per-task bucket; effective task speed is min(per-task, global); both runtime-changeable via odm.changeOption.
nodes.norm_label: global + per-task token bucket rate limiting

nodes.label: Probe chain (HEAD to single-stream fallback)
nodes.rationale: 3-step probe: HEAD, then ranged GET, then plain GET fallback; non-range servers get a single connection and the freed budget is redistributed in the same scheduling pass.

nodes.label: Config layering (CLI > user > system > defaults)
nodes.rationale: CLI args > ~/.config/odm/config.conf > /etc/odm/config.conf > defaults; a defaulted flag never overwrites a user file value; key = value lines, keys match CLI long-flags.
